commentary_segments.text: In this Chapter, all important aspects of bandgap and current references have been covered. Bandgap references have been discussed in great detail, in both bipolar and CMOS technologies. They can be made to operate below 1 V supply voltage. Current references are actually non-existing. Either discrete or MOST channel resistances are required for the voltage-current conversion. Finally, we have to remember that these references are required in ADCs but also in voltage and current regulators. The stability of these feedback loops is not always as obvious.
